    The replacement procedure of Skowroński–Waschbüsch (Lemma 2) #

    If the arrow α : i → j has two successors β, γ with βα, γα ≠ 0 and γα ∈ A·βα, replacing γ by γ (e_j - y) keeps every zero product of two arrows and kills γα (fix_succ); dually for two predecessors (fix_pred). Inducting on the number of nonzero products gives representatives satisfying the special biserial conditions (exists_good).
